form: Invention Disclosure Form (UM-16C), Curators of the University of Missouri
returns_to: Office of Technology Commercialization, UMKC, 801 E. 51st St., Flarsheim Hall 574, Kansas City, MO 64110 (ericwa@umkc.edu)

fill_modes.extract: The drafter can propose this from the manuscript or proposal text. The author reads it before submitting.
fill_modes.extract_verify: The drafter proposes a value only when the document states it plainly. The author must confirm it.
fill_modes.human: The document cannot answer this. The drafter leaves it blank and flags it.

fields.label: Non-confidential title of invention
fields.note: Brief; no confidential information, acronyms or trademarks.

fields.label: General description of the invention
Technical description and advantages over existing methods
The novel aspects of the invention
The problem this invention solves
How the invention differs from what others are doing
Disadvantages and limitations
Keywords associated with this invention
When was the invention conceived? (date, comments)
First written description (date, comments)
fields.note: A manuscript or proposal date may stand in for this.

fields.label: First public disclosure (date, comments)
fields.note: Drives the one-year U.S. patent window; a wrong date is costly, so the author confirms it.

fields.label: First model or prototype (date, comments)
First offer to sell the invention (date, comments)
Export control plan or controlled unclassified information (CUI)?
Past and future public disclosures: description/type, date or expected date, comments
fields.note: Prior publications and talks cited in the manuscript can be listed as candidates.

fields.label: I confirm there was no external funding support
Funding types: Federal, State, Corporate/Industry, Foundation, Research Consortium, SBIR/STTR, Other
Funding details: source name, grant/contract/award number, MoCode, principal investigator
fields.note: MoCode is internal to the university and is never in a manuscript, so it stays human-only. Federal funding triggers a required report to the agency.

fields.label: Were materials, data, technology or collaborations from a third party used?
Were there signed agreements governing the transfers or collaborations?
Agreement types (NDA, collaboration, research, consortia, inter-institutional, consulting, MOU, other) and the other parties
Potential inventors: name, employer/division/department at time of invention, current employer, email and phone, why each qualifies as an inventor
fields.note: Authors can seed the list. Inventorship is a legal question about who conceived the claims, not who authored the paper, so the author decides who is listed and why.

fields.label: Closest known products or technologies
Prior art: publications or patents describing something similar
fields.note: Only references the manuscript itself cites. No search is run.

fields.label: Potential licensees: company name, contact name, contact email
fields.note: The industry matcher may suggest company types, not named contacts.

fields.label: Submitter's name, date and signature, with certification that the information is true, accurate and complete
